correctness.rationale: PASS. At equilibrium (1,1,g,g), for q=m^2+n^2>=0 on (0,pi)^2 Neumann, the modal 4x4 determinant independently recomputed symbolically equals [((z+A)(z+E))^2+(z+E-gq)^2], A=2+3q/10, E=1+3q. Positive real z cannot solve it. Factorization into conjugate-coefficient quadratics yields exactly one positive gain imaginary-axis crossing g_c(q) with positive transverse real-part derivative. Exact symbolic computation independently verified g1=(85+189sqrt105)/100 and g2=(55+72sqrt205)/50 and the full quartic Routh-Hurwitz Delta2,Delta3 identities. For ALL q>=2, concavity of H(q,g) in g and explicitly coefficientwise positive shift H(2+h,g2) for h>0 ensure Delta3>0 on 0<=g<g2, with the remaining RH inequalities positive. The q=0 polynomial factors stably; q=1 is exactly two spatial modes cos x, cos y, each has one unstable conjugate pair for g1<g<g2. No finite mode sampling is substituted for the infinite-mode proof, and nothing nonlinear is claimed.
